title: WHEN JUDGMENT BECOMES NOISE: HOW DESIGN FAILURES IN LLM JUDGE BENCHMARKS SILENTLY UNDERMINE VALIDITY

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying schematic adherence using variance decomposition (linear and polynomial models) and measuring psychometric validity through Cronbach's alpha, Cross-Loading Ratio (CLR), and the Heterotrait-Monotrait (HTMT) ratio to detect factor collapse, rubric incoherence, and integration bias (weight disparity, weight entropy, and context stability) in LLM-as-a-judge benchmarks.
